title: _INVADERS
tagline: Space Invaders in first person. Endless waves, one blaster.
blurb: Waves of blocky aliens fly straight at you and you blast them before they land. Beginner mode is on by default, so you get an extra life while you learn the controls.
desc: _INVADERS, a first-person Space Invaders in WebGL by Andy K. S. Wong. Endless waves of aliens, free in your browser.
author: Andy K. S. Wong
controls: W A S D or arrows to move
Click, Enter or E to shoot
Touch: left half moves, right half looks, A fires
tags: invaders space aliens shooter first person webgl js13k
extraCredit: Co-op mode and the screenshot button are switched off in this copy because they need outside servers.
